name: Odin den' iz zhizni B'janki i S'erry
original_name: Один день из жизни Бьянки и Сьерры
source:
An unofficial prequel, or rather a modification for the novel Raid.

A slice of life novel that tells the story of Raid's two key characters, Bianca and Sierra, and the difficulties they face every day.

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-2787]Anivisiual[/url]]
translation:
视觉小说《Raid》的非官方前传，或者更准确地说，是一部改编模组。

这部日常题材视觉小说，讲述《Raid》的两位关键角色比安卡与西耶拉，以及她们每天面对的种种困难。

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/10-1-0-2787]Anivisual[/url]]
